job.question: What contract term, including any extension options, does the Los Angeles Fire and Police Pensions (LAFPP) RFP for financial statement audit services contemplate?
job.expected_facts: A three-year contract (fiscal years ending June 30, 2025, 2026 and 2027) with a maximum fee proposal for each fiscal year; the Board may extend beyond the three-year term through two one-year renewals.
job.acceptance: Three years plus two optional one-year renewals, up to five years, suffices. Fiscal-year dates and fee-proposal details are optional.

reviews.reason: This is Temple City’s RFP for deferred-compensation plan administration and record keeping, not LAFPP’s RFP for financial statement audit services. Its contract term is to be negotiated; the five-year pricing reference does not establish LAFPP’s term or renewal options.
quotes: City of Temple City, California 457 Deferred Compensation Plan Request for Proposals for Plan Administration and Record Keeping Services
The contract term will be negotiated at the conclusion of this RFP process.
purchasing requirements may stipulate that the maximum term available is limited to five years.
